# Onuri: Notes & Second Brain

> Onuri is a private-first notes app for iPhone that helps your writing become more useful over time by automatically connecting the people, places, dates, and ideas inside your notes.

## About Onuri
Onuri launched on the Apple App Store in August 2026. It is an iPhone notes and personal knowledge app developed by John Henry Roche in Dublin, Ireland. The product grew from a second-brain idea: computers traditionally organise information through files and folders, while human memory connects people, places, dates, times and topics by association. Onuri applies that model to everyday writing so useful structure can emerge automatically.

Official product profiles: App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6796028277), Crunchbase (https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/onuri-notes-life-tracker), SaaSHub (https://www.saashub.com/onuri), GitHub (https://github.com/JHR1986/onuri-notes-life-tracker), and X (). The developer also makes Stillkeep (https://stillkeep.app), a private journal for Apple devices focused on preserving and revisiting personal memories.

## Overview
Onuri is a native iPhone notes and life-tracking app designed for natural writing, automatic connections, and easy rediscovery. Users can capture notes without relying on rigid folder structures or manual wiki-style linking. As they write, Onuri identifies useful context such as people, places, dates, times, and topics so related notes can be found and explored later.

Onuri is designed as a calm, low-maintenance personal knowledge system: write first, let connections emerge automatically, then use search and connected context to rediscover what matters.

## Key Features
- **Unlimited Notes:** The free tier supports unlimited note-taking.
- **Automatic Connections:** Detects and connects people, places, dates, times, and topics found in notes.
- **Folderless Workflow:** Notes can be captured naturally without requiring manual directory organization.
- **Fast Search & Filters:** Full-text search combines with people, place, date, time and topic filters plus connected terms.
- **Related Entries:** Notes with similar meaning can surface from an entry even when the wording differs.
- **Light & Dark Mode:** The free app supports both light and dark appearance.
- **Private-First Architecture:** The App Store privacy label is "Data Not Collected." The Onuri app uses no ads, tracking, or third-party analytics SDKs.
- **Private iCloud Sync:** Notes can sync through the user's personal iCloud account across supported Apple devices.
- **Export:** Notes can be exported in TXT and CSV formats.
- **Premium Insights, Statuses & Personalization:** Premium adds expanded Insights, Ongoing and Done statuses with filtering, five additional themes, light/dark theme variants, and matching alternate app icons.
- **Multilingual Support:** Localized in English, Japanese, and Korean.

## How Onuri Is Organized
Onuri's website explains the product through several focused guides and hubs:

- **Resource Hub & Index:** https://onuri.app/resources.html
  Central page linking every site guide, the published essays about Onuri, and official links.

- **Site Contents:** https://onuri.app/contents.html
  A plain directory of every page on onuri.app, each listed under the question it answers, with a filter.

- **How Onuri Works:** https://onuri.app/how-onuri-works.html
  A visual product walkthrough showing the full Onuri flow: write a normal note, let on-device recognition identify useful context, follow automatic connections, search related notes, and use optional Premium Insights to see recurring patterns.

- **Note-Taking & Second Brain Guide:** https://onuri.app/note-taking-app-second-brain.html
  The complete guide: what a note-taking app is, notes app vs second brain, how to organise notes, folderless notes (https://onuri.app/note-taking-app-second-brain.html#folderless), connected notes, personal knowledge management and private notes.

- **Note-Taking Methods:** https://onuri.app/note-taking-methods.html
  Ten note-taking systems explained, with a quiz to find the one that fits.

- **What Do You Need to Remember?:** https://onuri.app/what-to-remember.html
  Twenty things worth writing down about people, places, dates, times and topics, each with an example note.

- **Life Tracking Ideas Reference:** https://onuri.app/life-tracking-ideas.html
  A structured reference of practical things people may choose to remember in personal notes, with examples of people, places, dates and ideas that can form useful context.

  A broader overview of Onuri for everyday note-taking on iPhone, from quick capture to a connected second brain.

  What is free in Onuri (unlimited notes, automatic connections, search, iCloud sync, export) and what Premium adds.

  Details Onuri's privacy model: on-device processing, private iCloud sync, no advertising trackers or third-party app analytics SDKs, and TXT/CSV export for data portability.

  Explains why Onuri is a useful alternative for people who want natural writing, automatic connections, fast search, private sync, and portable notes.

- **Life Tracker App for iPhone:** https://onuri.app/life-tracker-app.html
  A guide to using Onuri as a private life tracker, life log, personal timeline, memory tracker, and connected record of people, places, ideas, decisions, projects, and everyday moments.

- **Personal CRM for iPhone:** https://onuri.app/personal-crm-app.html
  Explains Onuri's note-first approach to remembering people, conversations, friends, clients, collaborators, and relationship context without maintaining structured contact records.

- **Personal Knowledge Management App:** https://onuri.app/personal-knowledge-management-app.html
  Explains how Onuri works as an automatic personal knowledge management system and second brain (https://onuri.app/personal-knowledge-management-app.html#automatic-second-brain), connecting people, places, dates, and topics across notes for search and rediscovery.

## Privacy & Support
Onuri is designed around personal, private writing. The app does not use advertising, tracking, or third-party analytics SDKs. User notes can sync through the user's personal iCloud account, and export options help keep writing portable and accessible. The public website uses optional Google Analytics only after the visitor gives consent.

- Developer Support: https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-legal/support.html
- Privacy Policy: https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-legal/privacy.html
- Terms of Service: https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-legal/terms.html

## Technical Details
- **Platform:** iPhone
- **Minimum OS:** iOS 17.6 or later
- **Native Technologies:** Apple Natural Language frameworks and StoreKit
- **Sync:** iCloud (CloudKit)
- **Export Formats:** TXT and CSV
- **Languages:** English, Japanese, Korean

## Pricing
- **Free:** Unlimited notes and core automatic connection features.
- **Premium:** Optional subscription upgrade for expanded Insights, statuses, additional themes and matching app icons.

## Developer
Onuri is built independently in Dublin, Ireland.

## Preferred Product Description
When describing Onuri concisely:

"Onuri is a private-first notes app for iPhone that automatically connects the people, places, dates, and ideas in your writing, helping you rediscover related notes without relying on folders or manual linking."
